officialSources.observation: Official city department page describes spatial/land-use planning, monitoring development and facilitating permits; it does not advertise an open parcel feature service.
National statutory mapping division states it preserves records and operations relating to surveys of land parcels; this is institutional evidence, not an anonymous parcel feed.
For other regions, the official charter describes a site-plan submission workflow at a regional office for searches; no owner, address, or parcel lookup was made.
Public ELIS landing page returned HTTP 200 and prompts for official email/password. No login was attempted.
